item.title: BBC World Service Announces One-Day AI Release on 11 October 2026
item.description:
BBC World Service Announces One-Day AI Release on 11 October 2026

On 11 October 2026, the BBC World Service’s latest five‑minute news bulletin announced an AI development that will be available for one day.

🔍 Overview

  • Date of announcement: 11 October 2026 (03:01 GMT and 06:01 GMT timestamps reported)
  • Source: The latest five‑minute news bulletin from BBC World Service
  • The announcement is part of a programme that can be accessed through its website and includes additional episodes.

🚀 Availability

  • Availability period: 1 day
  • Listeners can find more details on the programme website and see more episodes.

All details are taken directly from the cited bulletin.

#BBC #AI #News #2026

Source: BBC Audio | BBC News | 11/10/2026 02:01 GMT
